what_happens: Program executes "play this pulse at time t"
Controller accepts cmd into queue; due time fixed
interval_meaning: Acceptance delay; larger if queue full and core stalled

what_happens: Cmd reaches timeline side; can be compared against clock
interval_meaning: Lead margin; small/negative means late release
notes: E1 also fires on head refill after each pop (Verilator FIFO variant); only first-arrival rows are true E1

what_happens: Due passed; comparator releases cmd toward generator
number_recorded: time; time_abs; compare-fire and pop cycles
interval_meaning: Release offset (fixed controller delay); release spacing
measured_value: offset +4 t_clk (all heads); queued same-due spacing 4 t_clk

what_happens: Cmd arrives at SGv6 input (adapter boundary)
SGv6 takes cmd from queue and begins pulse
interval_meaning: Queue wait (0 idle, grows if busy); spacing preserved
expected: small idle; spacing = delta or nsamp b2b
measured_value: E4-E3 = 1 sg_clk idle; chained gap = nsamp (60)
notes: due -> SG start (head, SG idle) = 37.95-39.02 ns in test_sim; deterministic across identical reruns
E5 is per output burst, not per command

measured_value: burst length = sum of chained nsamp (180,120,120,180,120)
